answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 45801 Country: India Title: Names Question: In-shaAllah I am expecting a baby in the coming month. Could you please clarify if the following names have good meaning? Baby boy: Adyan, Rizaan Baby girl: Izma Raheen Answer ID: 45801 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 897/898/M=1434) The above mentioned names are not appropriate. Instead, you may choose any of the below mentioned names: For boy: Hassan, Affan, Safwan, Zakwan, Salman. For girl: Yumna, So’da, Rushda, Maimuna, Ruqayya, Sumayya. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
